gloss_en: transforming all of one's blood (the drops of blood of the nefesh/life-force) into words of Torah and prayer — the practice (from Likutey Moharan I:75) of speaking so extensively in Torah and tefillah that every drop of unserved blood is converted into holy speech, thereby rectifying the fallen sparks and nullifying contentiousness and dispute
canonical_he: נעשה מכל הדמים, דבורים של תורה ותפלה
